operations.instruction: Find qualifying documents and write their ids to selection.json, sorted alphabetically. Preserve the input files. Return the selected ids.

Use the document ids to join the qualifying documents to ledger.json. Add their integer weights exactly, write total.txt with that number and a final newline, and return the number. Preserve the input files.
Move each qualifying document from groups/<group>/ to selected/<group>/, retaining its filename and bytes. Leave other documents in place. Return the moved document ids sorted alphabetically.

Build an index one document at a time using iterateOn. Carry cursor and selected ids in state, stop when all documents have been judged, write sorted selected ids to selection.json and return them. Preserve the input files.
